propositions: Managed refs are marked at local creation (strictly monotonic) but cannot distinguish brand-new never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones, creating a blind spot in inbound removal logic
Direction-agnostic outbound ADD deduplication on (vendor_type, target_key) causes local links with vendor-type collisions to never be pushed and remain unprotected from inbound removal records
Inbound removal records for managed-but-never-peer-confirmed links must be declined and logged to prevent order-dependent deletion of local links the peer never carried

Peer confirmation evidence must persist durably with Jira linkId, direction, confirming snapshot pass_id, and confirmed-at time in a .bridge_state sidecar to survive ticket-log compaction and remain provider-agnostic
Removal convergence is honored only for links positively proven carried by the peer through successful outbound ADD application or authoritative complete snapshot observation
